title: Logical source order
description_en: Store and return the original logical Unicode sequence; do not reverse Hebrew strings or hand-swap brackets to simulate right-to-left display.
requirement: Store and return the original logical Unicode sequence; do not reverse Hebrew strings or hand-swap brackets to simulate right-to-left display.

title: Five final-letter forms
description_en: Preserve כ/ך מ/ם נ/ן פ/ף צ/ץ as supplied. Final forms are orthographic choices, not automatic end-of-word substitutions; names and loans may need editorial review.
requirement: Preserve כ/ך מ/ם נ/ן פ/ף צ/ץ as supplied. Final forms are orthographic choices, not automatic end-of-word substitutions; names and loans may need editorial review.

title: Niqqud and marks
description_en: Preserve vowel points, dagesh and distinct shin/sin dots even in otherwise unpointed text. Existing marks are not disposable decoration.
requirement: Preserve vowel points, dagesh and distinct shin/sin dots even in otherwise unpointed text. Existing marks are not disposable decoration.

title: Extended grapheme integrity
description_en: Keep base letters and all attached marks together for animation, truncation and highlighting; codepoints and UTF-16 elements are not displayed characters.
requirement: Keep base letters and all attached marks together for animation, truncation and highlighting; codepoints and UTF-16 elements are not displayed characters.

title: Script is not language
description_en: Explicit language or document context precedes script. Hebrew script can encode Yiddish or Ladino and does not prove modern he; unknown remains unresolved.
requirement: Explicit language or document context precedes script. Hebrew script can encode Yiddish or Ladino and does not prove modern he; unknown remains unresolved.

title: Language differs from direction
description_en: Declare known Hebrew language and RTL paragraph direction independently; right alignment alone does not establish a correct bidi paragraph or reading order.
requirement: Declare known Hebrew language and RTL paragraph direction independently; right alignment alone does not establish a correct bidi paragraph or reading order.

title: Known opposite-direction spans
description_en: Isolate complete semantic LTR spans such as product versions, URLs, email and amounts without swallowing surrounding sentence punctuation; preserve source order.
requirement: Isolate complete semantic LTR spans such as product versions, URLs, email and amounts without swallowing surrounding sentence punctuation; preserve source order.

title: Dynamic text and bidi controls
description_en: Use appropriate bdi or dir=auto for unknown dynamic strings when authoring markup. Plain-text isolates require a supported environment and a recorded diff; never silently remove existing controls.
requirement: Use appropriate bdi or dir=auto for unknown dynamic strings when authoring markup. Plain-text isolates require a supported environment and a recorded diff; never silently remove existing controls.

title: Functional punctuation
description_en: Keep geresh U+05F3, gershayim U+05F4 and maqaf U+05BE distinct from quotes, cantillation marks, minus signs and dashes; apply an explicit editorial policy instead of global replacement.
requirement: Keep geresh U+05F3, gershayim U+05F4 and maqaf U+05BE distinct from quotes, cantillation marks, minus signs and dashes; apply an explicit editorial policy instead of global replacement.

title: Word and line boundaries
description_en: Prefer ordinary word wrapping and the target engine's versioned line-breaking rules; do not apply break-all to all body copy or treat word segmentation as line breaking.
requirement: Prefer ordinary word wrapping and the target engine's versioned line-breaking rules; do not apply break-all to all body copy or treat word segmentation as line breaking.

title: Tracking and emphasis
description_en: Choose Hebrew tracking and emphasis by actual font and purpose; do not import Arabic kashida/tatweel or Latin tracking as a generic Hebrew solution.
requirement: Choose Hebrew tracking and emphasis by actual font and purpose; do not import Arabic kashida/tatweel or Latin tracking as a generic Hebrew solution.

title: Italic is a font decision
description_en: Inspect real italic or alternative emphasis in the chosen family, preserving readability and marks; neither mandatory italic nor an unconditional italic ban is justified.
requirement: Inspect real italic or alternative emphasis in the chosen family, preserving readability and marks; neither mandatory italic nor an unconditional italic ban is justified.

title: Glyph coverage and fallback
description_en: Inspect adopted font files, needed Hebrew and Latin glyphs, actual fallback and weights. A font-family declaration or successful load does not prove all glyphs render correctly.
requirement: Inspect adopted font files, needed Hebrew and Latin glyphs, actual fallback and weights. A font-family declaration or successful load does not prove all glyphs render correctly.

title: Mixed-script optical balance
description_en: Compare apparent body size, baseline, numerals, spacing and intended hierarchy locally rather than enforcing one Hebrew-Latin size multiplier.
requirement: Compare apparent body size, baseline, numerals, spacing and intended hierarchy locally rather than enforcing one Hebrew-Latin size multiplier.

title: Mark clearance in line boxes
description_en: Test pointed words and multiple marks at all adopted weights and output sizes for collisions or clipping; do not erase niqqud to fit a fixed-height box.
requirement: Test pointed words and multiple marks at all adopted weights and output sizes for collisions or clipping; do not erase niqqud to fit a fixed-height box.

title: Font license provenance
description_en: Record actual font origin, version, file hash and applicable license/embedding conditions before distribution; free download is not a license grant.
requirement: Record actual font origin, version, file hash and applicable license/embedding conditions before distribution; free download is not a license grant.

title: Address and grammatical policy
description_en: Separate grammar, addressee and editorial gender policy. Preserve dot/slash or other approved brand forms; do not infer a reader's gender from a name or address.
requirement: Separate grammar, addressee and editorial gender policy. Preserve dot/slash or other approved brand forms; do not infer a reader's gender from a name or address.

title: Meaning-preserving UI copy
description_en: Keep actions, consent, negation, costs, conditions and durations intact. Agreeing, reading and requesting are different actions and cannot be swapped to fit a CTA.
requirement: Keep actions, consent, negation, costs, conditions and durations intact. Agreeing, reading and requesting are different actions and cannot be swapped to fit a CTA.

title: Locale and typed values
description_en: Keep language, region, currency, numbering system, calendar and timezone separate. Preserve amount/currency and range endpoints instead of reversing digits or silently converting calendars.
requirement: Keep language, region, currency, numbering system, calendar and timezone separate. Preserve amount/currency and range endpoints instead of reversing digits or silently converting calendars.

title: Versioned plural messages
description_en: Select reviewed full phrases using the installed Hebrew plural data and visible decimal operands. A two category does not authorize arbitrary dual suffixes; record runtime and CLDR versions.
requirement: Select reviewed full phrases using the installed Hebrew plural data and visible decimal operands. A two category does not authorize arbitrary dual suffixes; record runtime and CLDR versions.

title: Meaningful reading and focus order
description_en: Check DOM/document order, keyboard order and visual order independently. row-reverse or global mirroring alone does not demonstrate meaningful RTL navigation.
requirement: Check DOM/document order, keyboard order and visual order independently. row-reverse or global mirroring alone does not demonstrate meaningful RTL navigation.

title: Zoom and spacing acceptance
description_en: Test actual 200% resizing, 320 CSS px-equivalent reflow and applicable user text-spacing separately; preserve content and function with documented exceptions.
requirement: Test actual 200% resizing, 320 CSS px-equivalent reflow and applicable user text-spacing separately; preserve content and function with documented exceptions.

title: Native document acceptance
description_en: Check paragraph/run direction, complex-script fonts, tables and marks in the actual Word or publishing engine, then reopen exported files; a static XML inspection is insufficient.
requirement: Check paragraph/run direction, complex-script fonts, tables and marks in the actual Word or publishing engine, then reopen exported files; a static XML inspection is insufficient.

title: PDF has two evidence layers
description_en: Review pixels for marks, fallback and layout, and separately compare Unicode extraction, search, copy and tagged reading order; searchable text is not PDF/UA certification.
requirement: Review pixels for marks, fallback and layout, and separately compare Unicode extraction, search, copy and tagged reading order; searchable text is not PDF/UA certification.

title: Scope before styling
description_en: Establish purpose, medium, audience, reading/display/hybrid role and authorized editing policy from available context; ask only for missing information that changes the work.
requirement: Establish purpose, medium, audience, reading/display/hybrid role and authorized editing policy from available context; ask only for missing information that changes the work.

title: Identity and logo protection
description_en: Keep official logos and exact product names intact; do not mirror lettering, maps or data axes merely because nearby text is RTL.
requirement: Keep official logos and exact product names intact; do not mirror lettering, maps or data axes merely because nearby text is RTL.

title: Specialized and historical scope
description_en: Preserve unsupported special marks and distinguish modern Hebrew guidance from cantillation, historical text or other Hebrew-script languages. State the limitation instead of deleting unknown characters.
requirement: Preserve unsupported special marks and distinguish modern Hebrew guidance from cantillation, historical text or other Hebrew-script languages. State the limitation instead of deleting unknown characters.

title: Evidence-specific reporting
description_en: Return source integrity, advisory findings and environment-specific evidence separately. Static checks never certify native spelling, glyph placement, screen readers or Office rendering.
requirement: Return source integrity, advisory findings and environment-specific evidence separately. Static checks never certify native spelling, glyph placement, screen readers or Office rendering.
